name: Town of West Hartford Leisure Services Camps
operator_name: Town of West Hartford Leisure Services
description_short: The Town of West Hartford's Leisure Services department runs summer and school-vacation camps for children ages 3 to 14. Camps include art, specialty, sports, nature and history camps, plus traditional camps in neighborhood parks.
special_needs_notes: The page says there is something for every child "no matter what his/her interests or abilities." The site has a separate Special Needs Recreation section, but this page gives no details on accommodations.
swim_waterfront_notes: The page says the traditional neighborhood park camps include swimming lessons. No pool or waterfront details are given.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This is a hub page for several town-run camps (Buena Vista, Busy Bees & Mini Busy Bees, Camp Funtastic, Discovery Zone / Discovery Zone Jr., Westmoor Park), not one camp. Each camp should probably be its own listing, built from its own page.
No season year, dates or prices appear on the page, so season_year is left blank.
The age ranges conflict: the intro says ages 3 to 14, but Busy Bees is listed as ages 2-5. Westmoor Park is listed as 4-13 in the body and 3-13 in the navigation. Buena Vista says '6-Teen'.
The phone number and address are the general West Hartford Town Hall line and address, not camp-specific contacts.
